description: Source code implementing dequantization functions for MPEG and H.263 video codecs, including intra and inter block processing, with support for fast IDCT and prediction structures.

methods.name: VlcDequantMpegIntraBlock
methods.description: Decodes and dequantizes an intra 8x8 block using MPEG mode, with support for prediction and clipping.

methods.name: VlcDequantMpegInterBlock
methods.description: Decodes and dequantizes an inter 8x8 block using MPEG mode, with support for prediction and clipping.

methods.name: VlcDequantH263IntraBlock
methods.description: Decodes and dequantizes an intra 8x8 block using H.263 mode, with support for prediction and clipping.

methods.name: VlcDequantH263InterBlock
methods.description: Decodes and dequantizes an inter 8x8 block using H.263 mode, with support for prediction and clipping.

methods.name: VlcDequantH263IntraBlock_SH
methods.description: Decodes and dequantizes an intra 8x8 block in SH mode for H.263, with support for prediction and clipping.

methods.name: VlcDequantH263InterBlock
methods.description: Decodes and dequantizes an inter 8x8 block in SH mode for H.263, with support for prediction and clipping.
